pages.text: A walk in Zanzibar, what do you see? Shops selling sweets, in very narrow streets.
A swim in Zanzibar, what do you see? Changu, Kibua, Tasi, Pono, Jodari na Kambisi.
A drive in Zanzibar, what do you see? Animals in a jungle, watching at an angle
A dance in Zanzibar, what do you see? Swahili, English and Arab, all dancing Taarab.
A drink in Zanzibar, what do you see? miwa, madafu juicy, coffee and tea are spicy.
A trip to Zanzibar, do you wish to go back?
